evidence: One byte-aligned, pad-free 2492-byte run (0xC3A0..0xCD5C) with a single hand-written frame style: framed routines read and write SI/DI without saving them, which Turbo C never does around inline asm naming those registers (probe: SNDSCL4 + M_C5A8_C5C6 compiled as one C unit gains push si/pop si and is 6 bytes longer).

Register-ABI helpers save AX/CX/DX/BX inside frames (F_C1A0, F_C7CB, F_C834, F_C877, F_CAF1); the OPL data write (F_C898) ends in a REPT 35 in al,dx delay; all in-cluster calls are fixup-free relative calls, i.e. caller and callee were assembled together.

The seven former C wrappers (F_C59A, F_C8E2, F_C988, F_CAD0, F_CADB, F_CAE6, F_CB48) reproduced their frames only through invented -k flags or dummy parameters; the following C unit OPTIONS (M_CB5C_CD23) grows 4 bytes per function under -k, so no -k unit existed here. tools/audit_tu_flags.py now reports 0 unexplained flags.

Former per-module evidence (SI-relative voice state at DS:17A4..17F4, ES:DI stream cursors, LOOP/LODS/XLAT bodies, mov bp,sp argument patching) is retained in the module comments of asm/SOUND.ASM and in recovery/asm/ + recovery/src/ (the 18 retired sources).

capsules.reason: `db 0e9h` -- the first byte of a near-jmp opcode whose displacement is computed from instruction labels (per the module's own header: 'Table addresses derive from instruction labels; only the loader ABI base is fixed'). This is a single opcode byte kept literal because TASM's own `jmp` mnemonic would need the same encoding; not an opaque multi-instruction capsule.
capsules.note: Single-byte opcode literal, not a capsule; included for completeness.

capsules.reason: 16 lines x 16 bytes of a fixed `0Fh,0F0h` planar/EGA bit-mask table (classic VGA/EGA plane-select mask ramp pattern: 0FFh row then descending 0Fh-prefixed rows). This is a genuine binary lookup table (graphics mask data), not encoded instructions -- no opcode structure, purely repetitive mask constants consumed as data by the video routines.
capsules.note: Data table, correctly left as db; not an instruction capsule.
